# CWR qualification registry (task 0.2; spec/cwr/verification.md sections 2 and 5).
# One [case.CWR-NNN] block per stable case. Identity, tier, reqs and tasks mirror spec/cwr/spec.kvx; the
# expected assertion inventory a1..aN is drawn from the case's required independent oracle. An assertion id
# on the wire is "<case>.<key>", for example "CWR-019.a1".
#
# Keys per case:
#   title, tier, reqs, tasks   identity, cross-checked against spec/cwr/spec.kvx by tests/cwr/qualify.py
#   a1 .. aN                   the registered assertion inventory (consecutive from a1); a case without an
#                              inventory can never be marked PASS
#   subsets                    task id -> the registered component subset that task's driver reports; the
#                              union covers the inventory; a task-scope PASS never changes the case status
#   requires_build             true when a PASS must name a registered Build hash
#   registered_builds          sha256:<64hex> Build hashes a PASS may use; empty until the Builds exist
#   registered_seeds           seeds a PASS may use; empty means any seed recorded in the ledger header
#   cassette_digest            registered cassette set digest or null; when set a PASS must match it
#   status, evidence           UNRUN with evidence null, or the outcome of the latest checker-accepted
#                              case-scope attempt record (in attempt-index order) and that record's repository
#                              path; written only by tests/cwr/qualify.py
# [meta] index_length and index_head pin the hash-chained append-only attempt index
# tests/cwr/evidence/index.jsonl (number of entries and sha256 of the last line; null when empty). Only
# tests/cwr/qualify.py appends to the index and re-pins the head, under one lock; a record that is not an
# index entry, an indexed record that is missing and a rewritten entry are all detected by the checker.
# Each assertion is recomputed by an independent oracle (built into tests/cwr/check_evidence.py for CWR-019,
# tests/cwr/oracles/CWR_NNN.py for every other case, added by the task that owns the case); an assertion with
# no oracle is UNVERIFIED and can never be PASS.
# Campaign cases also carry matrix (hypothesis -> arms, task count, seeds per task) and
# preregistration_digest (null until benchmark/preregistration.kvx is committed); a campaign PASS needs the
# complete matrix and a matching pre-registration digest.
# Every experimental arm is a CWR Build with one pillar ablated; nothing here names any other agent or harness.
